Tucker Carlson devotes this episode to what he calls the secret history of the Bible's strangest figures. They are the giants and demons of scripture. He also covers the advanced civilizations he says flourished before the Great Flood destroyed them. The discussion treats the early chapters of Genesis as a suppressed record rather than myth.

Carlson and his material move between the biblical text, ancient sources, and modern alternative archaeology. The flood story appears in many cultures, and the episode leans on that spread as evidence of a real, shared memory. Mainstream scholars read these texts differently, and listeners should know the claims are contested. Preserved here is a popular broadcaster's full argument that the ancient world was stranger, and better informed, than the modern one admits.
